Notes_and_Tips: Take your thyroid medication on an empty stomach with plain water and wait at least 30–60 minutes before your first meal, if prescribed by your doctor.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Continue practicing yoga regularly and include a 30-minute walk on most days to support thyroid health and weight management.
If following a vegan diet long-term, discuss Vitamin B12 supplementation with your healthcare provider, as it may be appropriate.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily.
Maintain consistent meal timings despite your late work schedule.
